title: 16th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/3/2025).
Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas calling for no permission to be given for catching sharks or shark fishing in the Maldives.

Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to determine members' view on the government delaying flat handovers to many of the 4,000 beneficiaries of the Gedhoruveriya scheme, leaving reclamation at Gulhifalhu, Giraavarufalhu and Hulhumalé Phase 3 under the first Binveriya scheme unfinished, and ignoring the rights of applicants for Hulhumalé flats and Uthuru Thilafalhu land under the second Gedhoruveriya/Binveriya scheme while prioritising the Ras Malé project, costing thousands of Maldivians their right to housing.
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Bill amending Law No. 11/2022 (Evidence Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Bilehdhoo MP Ahmed Aslam.
Report of the Committee of the Whole House on its review of the Bill amending Law No. 24/2014 (Special Economic Zones Act).
Report of the National Development and Heritage Committee on its review of the Bill amending Law No. 7/2021 (Maldives Higher Education and Training Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to open debate on a resolution against shark fishing, continue debates on the housing resolution and the Evidence Act amendment, and take up committee reports on the Special Economic Zones and Higher Education bills.
